parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles, sub_cr.compound_name AS substrate_compound_name, drug_cr.compound_name AS parent_compound_name, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key, m.organism, m.enzyme_name FROM metabolism m LEFT JOIN compound_records sub_cr ON m.substrate_record_id = sub_cr.record_id LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON sub_cr.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records drug_cr ON m.drug_record_id = drug_cr.record_id WHERE m.enzyme_name = 'CYP2D6' ORDER BY cs.canonical_smiles, sub_cr.compound_name, drug_cr.compound_name, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key, m.organism, m.enzyme_name LIMIT 200
